LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAH.title: Underground Demolition Expert
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAH.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a demolition expert in the revolutionary army. [PAWN_pronoun] is skilled in making and using various explosives, and frequently maintains these dangerous weapons in the underground bases.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAI.title: Ratkin Spy
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAI.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the guerrilla's most skilled infiltrator and intelligence gatherer. [PAWN_pronoun] has disguised [PAWN_objective]self as refugees to infiltrate enemy camps multiple times, bringing back valuable information.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAJ.title: Plague Medic
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAJ.description: During the plague outbreak, [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a medic treating countless comrades. [PAWN_pronoun] has extensive experience with various bacteria and toxins, but has become somewhat neurotic because of it.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAK.title: Ratkin Sniper
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAK.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an elite sniper in the revolutionary army. [PAWN_pronoun] could accurately hit targets from hundreds of meters away, but after the plague, [PAWN_pronoun] grew weary of killing.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAL.title: Underground Mechanic
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAL.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a mechanical maintenance soldier in the royal army who defected to the guerrillas during the war. [PAWN_pronoun] now maintains the guerrillas' various mechanical equipment and weapons.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAM.title: Ratkin Chef
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAM.description: Food supplies are crucial in underground bases, and [PAWN_nameDef] serves as head chef responsible for turning various strange ingredients into edible food. [PAWN_possessive] cooking skills have saved many lives.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAN.title: Tunnel Digger
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAN.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the guerrillas' most skilled tunneling expert. [PAWN_pronoun] can carve out complex tunnel networks in hard rock, greatly benefiting the guerrillas' operations.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAP.title: Underground Guard Captain
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAP.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for guarding the guerrillas' main base. [PAWN_pronoun] has repelled many enemy invasions and is an experienced defensive expert.
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAQ.title: Ratkin Scholar
LanguageData.RKU_GuerrillaAQ.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once worked in the royal library and possesses vast knowledge. [PAWN_pronoun] now uses this knowledge to help the guerrillas analyze enemy situations and formulate strategies.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCJ.title: Plague Orphan
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCJ.description: All of [PAWN_nameDef]'s family died in the plague. [PAWN_pronoun] was adopted by the guerrillas and has an instinctive fear of biological weapons, but this has made [PAWN_objective] stronger.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCM.title: Underground Child Cook
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCM.description: From a very young age, [PAWN_nameDef] began learning to cook. [PAWN_pronoun] can make delicious food from the most basic ingredients, which everyone loves to eat.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCN.title: Ratkin Child Guard
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCN.description: Though young, [PAWN_nameDef] has already learned basic defensive techniques. [PAWN_pronoun] often stands watch at the sentry posts, vigilantly observing the surroundings.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCP.title: Ratkin Child Miner
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCP.description: In the underground mines, [PAWN_nameDef] is the hardest-working child miner among them. [PAWN_pronoun] can accurately find the best mining points for ore.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCQ.title: Underground Child Scholar
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCQ.description: [PAWN_nameDef] likes to read the few books the guerrillas have. [PAWN_pronoun] has a strong thirst for knowledge and often asks questions that are difficult for adults to answer.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCS.title: Underground Child Farmer
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuerrillaCS.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for tending to the mushrooms and moss the guerrillas cultivate. [PAWN_pronoun] knows these underground crops inside out and can make them thrive in poor soil.
